column1: # Fill sets (vignettes): small themed groups of filler props in a fixed local layout (filllayout 2026-11-15; Docs/FillPlan.md

column10: Z: metres in the set's own frame
column11: Unreal axes (Z: lift above the ground

column1: # a pot on a table). Yaw: Unreal yaw in the set frame. Every kind's own front is its local +Y (Tools/filler_clean.py: front = Blender -Y)
# and a set's front (the side that faces the street or the viewer) is also its +Y. Wall-backed sets (named in the comment above them)
# have their back on Y = 0: nothing of them is behind that line. Sizes are the GLBs' as drawn (1.2x real)
# Flags ('|'-separated): drop = seeded variation may leave it out; alt=A/B = may become one of these same-size siblings;
# turn=N = seeded yaw jitter up to +-N degrees (round kinds only); stack = stands on another piece of the set (no ground footprint);
# hang = hung on a wall or post (no ground footprint
column2: never solid). Flames are their own rows (TorchBlazingFlame etc.

column2: so a set's own pieces need no overlap test against each other.
